title.zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6及“智能界面”，回答可含图表与按钮
title.en: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with Intelligent UI

summary.zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6，ChatGPT回答可包含交互式图表、表单、按钮和示意图；付费用户使用GPT-6 Sol，免费和Go用户使用GPT-6 Luna。
summary.en: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 with "Intelligent UI," letting ChatGPT answers include interactive charts, forms and buttons; paid tiers get GPT-6 Sol and Free/Go users GPT-6 Luna.

body.zh:
OpenAI在官方博客宣布向所有用户推出GPT-6，并引入“智能界面”（Intelligent UI）：ChatGPT可直接在回答中生成交互式图表、表单、按钮、示意图和任务工具。

据[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1007276/openai-chatgpt-intelligent-ui-gpt-6)报道，付费档位获得GPT-6 Sol，免费和Go用户获得GPT-6 Luna。
body.en:
In a [blog post](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/), OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 to everyone along with Intelligent UI, which lets ChatGPT build interactive charts, forms, buttons, diagrams and task tools into replies.

[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1007276/openai-chatgpt-intelligent-ui-gpt-6) reported paid tiers get GPT-6 Sol while Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna.

title.zh: 谷歌向全球开放SynthID检测器

summary.zh: 谷歌开放SynthID Detector，用户可检测由谷歌及合作伙伴工具生成的图像、视频和音频。
summary.en: Google opened its SynthID Detector globally so users can check AI-generated images, video and audio from Google and partner tools.

title.zh: 一艘巴拿马籍船只在阿曼附近海域遇袭起火
title.en: Panama-flagged vessel struck and set ablaze off Oman

summary.zh: 阿纳多卢称，一艘巴拿马籍船只在阿曼外海遇袭起火，10名船员被疏散。
summary.en: A Panama-flagged vessel was struck and set ablaze off Oman, with 10 crew evacuated, Anadolu reported.

title.zh: 特朗普称将与普京通话 俄罗斯疑现肺鼠疫病例
title.en: Trump says Putin call scheduled amid Russia plague reports

summary.zh: 特朗普表示已安排与普京通话，此前俄罗斯伊尔库茨克州报告疑似肺鼠疫致死病例。
summary.en: Trump said a call with Putin was scheduled after reports of a suspected fatal pneumonic plague case in Russia's Irkutsk region.

title.zh: 立陶宛推进涉核武器的宪法修正案

summary.zh: 立陶宛推进一项涉及核武器的宪法修正案；卡塔尔继续斡旋美伊接触。
summary.en: Lithuania moved on a constitutional amendment concerning nuclear weapons, while Qatar mediated US-Iran contacts.

title.zh: 美债收益率上升 美股自纪录高位回落
title.en: Wall Street retreats from record highs

summary.en: On Oct. 7 the Dow fell 0.7%, the S&P 500 slipped 0.2% to 7,801.77 and the Russell 2000 lost 1.3%.

summary.zh: 《新闻联播》报道，各地秋粮收获加快，全国已收获过四成；国庆假期公园游客超2.1亿人次。
summary.en: CCTV reported China's autumn harvest more than 40% complete and over 210 million park visits during the holiday.

title.zh: 中老铁路跨境货值突破千亿元
title.en: China-Laos Railway cargo value tops 100 billion yuan

summary.zh: 国内联播快讯：中老铁路货值破千亿元，“三北”工程完成2.65亿亩任务。
summary.en: CCTV briefs: China-Laos Railway cargo value topped 100 billion yuan, and the Three-North shelterbelt hit 265 million mu.
